title: How many percent of 'Gold' cards were issued prior to 1998?
question: How many percent of 'Gold' cards were issued prior to 1998?

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', T1.issued) < '1998' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.card_id)
FROM card_info AS T1
WHERE T1.type = 'Gold'
